worktree_layout.teardown: After merge, with both git status --porcelain empty: remove the cli worktree first, then the outer worktree if one exists.

execution.tests: Build lanes run targeted test files only. The full npm test runs only in the merge lane. cr097/cr101 bind fixed ports (flashcard 2026-09-26 #test-harness #ports).
execution.integration: A story integrates once all its upstream stories have merged. In its cli worktree: git merge --no-ff main. On a conflict, the owner's file wins and the story re-applies its insertions. If two blocks were appended at the end of a test file, keep both, upstream first. A conflict inside an existing test goes to QA-Red. Then re-run prebuild, typecheck and the targeted tests, and run QA-Verify and post-flight on the integrated tree. If main moves before the merge, integrate again.
